audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named a single Renekton ability (flagged in packet defects), so "his stun" and "his fury bar" had no cooldown or condition attached.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is his W on 16/14/12/10/8s; Cull the Meek is Q (7s, heals him); Slice and Dice is E (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s); Dominus is R; Reign of Anger is the Fury passive. Naming them turns "dodge his stun" into "sidestep Ruthless Predator and commit inside its 16 seconds".
audit.corrected: All five names introduced across spikes[0], early, mid, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0], with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Fury spike was described as a vague "fury bar full" without saying what changes.
audit.why: Riot's text: above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator slashes three times, stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, and DESTROYS DAMAGE SHIELDS; Slice and Dice empowered also reduces Armor. The Fury bar is a readable, binary power spike on his side, and the shield destruction matters if you are running any shielding.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and early now state the 50-Fury threshold, the 1.5s stun and the shield destruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The empowered W was called "the stun" with no mention that it strips shields, and his sustain was never attributed.
audit.why: Cull the Meek (Q, 7s) heals him for a portion of the damage dealt and heals more above 50 Fury — that is the sustain your extended-trade plan has to out-pace, and it is the concrete case for Grievous Wounds in this lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] now states the shield destruction; the Q heal is recorded here for the itemisation pass.

edits.before: This is Renekton's window, not yours — with 3 Q casts he needs to dodge Renekton's stun (empowered W) and W-slice combo. Don't try to trade until you have all three Q casts and E charges up; even then, back off if his fury bar is full.
edits.after: This is Renekton's window, not yours: above 50 Fury his Ruthless Predator (W) stuns for 1.5s and destroys damage shields. Don't trade until you have all three Q casts and E charges up; even then, back off if his Fury bar is full.

edits.before: Bait his empowered W stun, then punish the cooldown with Q-sweetspot + E drain
edits.after: Bait his empowered Ruthless Predator, then punish the 16s with Q-sweetspot + E drain

edits.before: Renekton owns levels 1-2: his auto-attacks and fury generation let him win any point-blank exchange before your Q pattern comes online. Do not contest last hits inside his range — take the CS you can safely and give ground when his fury bar fills, because an empowered W stun into a slice-and-dice combo can chunk half your bar. Hold your E charges purely for disengage here, not for trades. Ward the river; a fed Renekton plus jungle pressure is how this lane ends.
edits.after: Renekton owns levels 1-2: Reign of Anger builds Fury off his attacks and he wins any point-blank exchange before your Q pattern comes online. Don't contest last hits in his range — take safe CS and give ground when the Fury bar fills, because an empowered Ruthless Predator (W) stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s and leads into Slice and Dice (E) for half your bar. Hold E charges purely for disengage. Ward the river; a fed Renekton plus jungle pressure ends this lane.

edits.before: By level 3 you have a Q pattern but Renekton still trades better, so play the dodge game — sidestep his empowered W (the stun) and only commit when it's on cooldown. From level 6, World Ender is your equalizer: hold it to answer his all-in, ride the heal amp and E lifesteal through his burst, and land Q sweetspots to reset the drain. Track his stun cooldown obsessively; that single ability is the whole matchup.
edits.after: By level 3 you have a Q pattern but Renekton still trades better, so play the dodge game — sidestep Ruthless Predator (W) and only commit while its 16s is running. From level 6, World Ender is your equalizer: hold it to answer his all-in, ride the heal amp and E lifesteal through his burst, and land Q sweetspots to reset the drain. Track that 16s stun obsessively; that one ability is the whole matchup.

edits.before: Snowball the early levels with W-stun into fury-empowered combos
edits.after: Snowball early with the Ruthless Predator stun into Fury combos

notes: Renekton's Cull the Meek (Q) heals him, more so above 50 Fury — a genuine anti-heal case that the page's itemisation does not currently mention. Not added for space. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only); no grounding claim was made in this slice.
